/kind cleanup

> /kind documentation

If no, just write "NONE" in the release-note block below.

-->
```release-note
NONE
```

**Additional documentation e.g., KEPs (Kubernetes Enhancement Proposals), usage docs, etc.**:

<!--
This section can be blank if this pull request does not require a release note.

When adding links which point to resources within git repositories, like
KEPs or supporting documentation, please reference a specific commit and avoid
linking directly to the master branch. This ensures that links reference a
specific point in time, rather than a document that may change over time.

See here for guidance on getting permanent links to files: https://help.github.com/en/articles/getting-permanent-links-to-files

Please use the following format for linking documentation:
- [KEP]: <link>
- [Usage]: <link>
- [Other doc]: <link>
-->
```docs

```

I think we could change it but at the time I was focused on the "API" changes to the image that couldn't be done with a simple PR.

I'll double check what changing that would entail,
/hold

... turns out that's going to require "API" changes too.

rolling up the first part of that here, since it also touches the conformance test descriptions
will file a follow-up to upgrade the image again and update the deployments again

issue_context.title: agnhost e2e image inconsistent versions
issue_context.body:
I went to update the image usage after https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/87105 and discovered:
- `test/images/agnhost/VERSION` is `2.18`
- `test/images/agnhost/agnhost.go`'s root command has version `2.17`
- `test/utils/image/manifest.go` has agnhost versions `2.13` and `2.6`

/sig testing
/sig release
/kind bug
/assign
comments:
- https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/92106 aligns 1) and 2) (my bad!)
- https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/92119 bumps the manifest and updates for the changes in agnhost. the 2.6 version seems inconsequential, the image is pulled only. (testing private registry)

review_comments: I've already drafted the changes to these for after the e2e image is pushed
